name: RomM
short_desc: Self-hosted game library that plays retro games in your browser, on your own device.
author: rommapp
description: RomM (ROM Manager) scans your game collection, adds cover art and descriptions, and lets you play games straight from the browser. Emulation runs on the device you play on (EmulatorJS, Ruffle and js-dos compiled to WebAssembly), so the server only stores and serves the files.

form_fields.label: ROM library folder
form_fields.pattern_error: Use a full path such as /mnt/hdd/games: letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores, no spaces or trailing slash.
form_fields.hint: Where your games live, e.g. a folder on an HDD such as /mnt/hdd/games. Put games in <folder>/roms/<platform>/ (e.g. roms/snes/) and BIOS files in <folder>/bios/<platform>/. Leave empty to use Runtipi's media/data/roms folder. The drive must be mounted in the Runtipi server.

form_fields.label: ScreenScraper username
form_fields.hint: Optional. A free screenscraper.fr account adds box art, screenshots and manuals.

form_fields.label: RetroAchievements API key
form_fields.hint: Optional. From retroachievements.org/settings. Shows achievement progress.

form_fields.label: SteamGridDB API key
form_fields.hint: Optional. Adds alternative, higher-quality cover art.

form_fields.label: IGDB client ID
form_fields.hint: Optional. Needs a Twitch developer app. Adds related games and more screenshots.
